scenario: LDIA.3.4.2 — a construct the resolved settings do not permit is DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED at the construct. The program overrides `default` with `regex: false` and then matches a regex in its own rule. Drives per-construct validation of the program's own module; LDIA.2.10.9 pins the same check inside an imported library.
rules_ds:
use default:
    regex: false

schema Msg scope logical:
    id: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text ~ /alarm/
->
    log info "x"
